LESSON: SELF- EXPLORATION AND CAREER DEVELOPMENT

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Foundations of Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 1.3: Self- Exploration and Career Development
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Self- Exploration and Career Development, part of Foundations of Pre-Technical Studies in Grade 9 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How are talents and abilities nurtured? 2. Why is self- exploration necessary for career development?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss and present on ways of nurturing talents and abilities,

2. display talents and abilities through clubs and societies and other planned school activities,

3. make a list of talents and abilities and their corresponding career pathways,

4. engage with a resource person on career opportunities related to talents and abilities,

5. discuss a case scenario on ethical and unethical practices related to the use of talents and abilities,

6. make presentations on careers of choice based on talents and abilities. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss and present on ways of nurturing talents and abilities,
2. display talents and abilities through clubs and societies and other planned school activities,
3. make a list of talents and abilities and their corresponding career pathways,
4. engage with a resource person on career opportunities related to talents and abilities,
5. discuss a case scenario on ethical and unethical practices related to the use of talents and abilities,
6. make presentations on careers of choice based on talents and abilities. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Self- Exploration and Career Development together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: learner acquire interpretation and inference skills when reading and analysing a

case scenario on ethical and unethical practices.

• Creativity and Imagination: learner acquires networking skills when displaying talents and abilities through clubs,

societies and other planned school activities.

6

Values:
● Integrity: learner develops a sense of accountability when analysing a case scenario on ethical and unethical practices

related to the use of talents and abilities.

• Respect: learner shows open-mindedness when discussing and presenting on ways of nurturing talents and abilities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Social Cohesion: learner cooperates with others when demonstrating their talents and abilities during talent shows.

• Peer Education and Mentorship: learner exchanges ideas with others when displaying talents and abilities through clubs

and societies.

Link to other Subjects:

Creative Arts and Sports: learner enhances creativity when displaying talents and abilities through clubs and societies.
